lines.t: We wrapped your wounds in linen
Trembling hands, unswollen eyes
Carried spices through the garden
Where the shadows seemed to rise
Pharisee, by day I spoke of law and sacrifice
By night I came in whispers
Afraid to pay the price
Now I kneel beside your body
Every doctrine turned to dust
All my robes of reputation stained by broken trust
How could I weigh your worth with scales of human pride?
How could I stand in council while they nailed you to the sky?
Stone at the tomb, stone on my heart
Sealed in the dark where I tore you apart
Oh Yahushua, son I fear to claim
I hid in the light while I loved you in the dark
Now I weep in the dust with your holy name
Burned like fire on a Pharisee's heart
I was a teacher who never had sight
Blind in the law while I shunned the light
Yet here by your grave every title falls apart
You are the life and you're breaking my heart
And you're breaking my heart
I taught of wrath and judgment, weighed men on a bitter scale
Built walls of learning, sentences that doomed the weak to fail
I honored all our fathers, yet the Holy One stood near
And I feared the loss of favor more than I feared my fear
I washed my hands in ritual, but not in living tears
I guarded every boundary line, but not your pierced ears
Now the Lamb lies cold before me, and I finally understand
Understand all our alters were but shadows of these wounds in your hand
Stone at the tomb, stone on my heart
Crushed by the weight of the role I played in the dark
Oh Yahushua, son I fear to claim
I hid in the light while I loved you in the dark
Now I weep in the dust with your holy name
Burn like fire on a Pharisee's heart
I was a teacher who never had sight
Blind in the law while I shunned the light
Here by your grave every title falls apart
You are the life and you're breaking my heart
Day of the Lord on my learned head
All I trusted shaking every doctrine dead
I feel the fire of your jealousy burn
As the proud are broken and the little ones learn
If there is mercy for shepherds who stray
If there is refuge in the storm of that day
Then let this old heart be torn down, rebuilt
Let even a Pharisee be washed from his guilt
At dawn they ran back breathless
With a terror in their eyes
The tomb is bare, the stone is gone, he's risen from the cries
My knees gave way like cedars when the mountains start to shake
The fear of holy judgment turned to joy I couldn't fake
If death has lost its kingdom, if the grave has lost its key
Then even one like Nicodemus finds a road to be set free
You broke the stone that sealed you in and shattered mine within
The teacher I once questioned has become my life again
Oh Yahushua, now I bear your name
I stepped from the dark and I stand in your light
All my learning and loss I lay in the flame
Let it burn, let it die, let your mercy rewrite
I was the teacher who never had sight
Now I bow to the king and resurrect delight
From night of lament to a fire in my chest
You rose from the grave and my religion found rest
Night of spices
Dawn of fire
A Pharisee falls and the sun rises higher
Thank you.
